Title: Azure Active Directory support in Azure Database for PostgreSQL - single server

Body.Content:
Active Directory integration for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single server is now available in preview. Using this new integration, you can securely sign in to your database by using Active Directory and manage credentials in a central place. For consistent role management, manage database access by using Active Directory groups.

For more information, see our service documentation.

Learn more about Azure Database - Single server
